arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours. Right-facing standing profile. One bent arm is lifted and sweeps across the forehead/head level, its forearm projecting strongly toward SCREEN-LEFT at about the top of the cap; the upper arm/elbow bends out on SCREEN-RIGHT beside the head. The other arm stays lowered beside the left edge of the torso. Preserve the source's crossed high gesture rather than an ordinary salute or straight forward point. Close standing legs and offset right-pointing shoes.
